About full-body PPF

Every panel, protected.

Full-body PPF covers every painted panel, so the whole car is protected from stone chips, scratches and road salt — not just the front. Choose Gloss PPF to keep the factory shine, Matte PPF to turn gloss paint into a satin-matte finish while protecting it, or Colour PPF for a new colour and paint protection in one layer.

We install XPEL Ultimate Plus, which carries a 10-year manufacturer warranty against yellowing, cracking and delamination. The paint is washed and decontaminated first so nothing is sealed under the film — new vehicles get a decontamination wash, and used ones a light polish so existing defects are not locked in.

Like a wrap, the film can be removed later, and the paint underneath is protected for as long as it is on. Only need the impact zones? See PPF بخشی جلو, or add a ceramic coating on top for easier washing.
